scope: Archive 064, the mystery-data result messages. 132 records over 22 distinct lines, so the wording is authored by source line. Identical in both revisions.
provenance: Claude translator-authored Japanese to Korean, 2026-09-20; no independent review yet
tone: Flat narration of a result, 해라체.
notes: Every pickup line here has an item name inserted before the closing bracket, so the Korean cannot choose a subject particle: 「X」획득!! and 「X」의 효력이 발휘됐다!! avoid it. The lone middle dot is a pause marker and becomes a full stop, because the katakana middle dot is in the range the gate treats as untranslated Japanese.
